description: Verify that DUT emits exactly PROBE_NUM = 3 ARP Probes during the Link-Local probing phase (RFC 3927 §2.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.2.1 specifies the prober sends PROBE_NUM = 3 ARP Probes before claiming the tentative address. Fewer Probes weakens conflict detection. This case observes the entire probing window and asserts at least 3 Probes are emitted.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine; cadence verification cases like this one intentionally forgo the fast envelope so the timing observation matches the spec-mandated rates: PROBE_WAIT 1 s, PROBE_MIN..MAX 1..2 s)

2. Observation (probing window):
   • DUT → wire: 3 ARP Probes targeting the same tentative LL address   ← key check

[Pass condition]
3 ARP Probes observed before the deadline.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_probes — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
• Fail_too_few_probes — fewer than 3 Probes within the deadline

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted PROBE_NUM = 3 ARP Probes — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_too_few_probes: Fewer than 3 ARP Probes within the deadline
